output.user_reply:
To resolve the deprecation error you're encountering, you should remove any references to `global.disableWatchdogWarning` from your configuration. Instead, you can use the `--server.fileWatcherType none` option to suppress file watching. Since you mentioned that you can define environment variables or create a config.toml file, you can set the following in your config.toml:

```toml
[server]
fileWatcherType = "none"
```
This should help you avoid the deprecation warning and allow your app to run smoothly on Posit Connect. If you continue to face issues, please let me know.
